name: Rolcon Engineering Company Limited
about: Rolcon Engineering Company Limited manufactures and sells industrial chains and sprocket wheels in India, Asia, Africa, and North America. The company offers drive chains, conveyor chains, leaf chains, special purpose chains, sprockets, and special sprocket-shaft assembly products. Its products are used in steel, cement, chemical and fertilizer, power and energy, DI pipe, edible and palm oil, food, sugar, pulp and paper, mining, automotive, and other industries. The company markets its products under the ROL-KOBO brand through distributors. It also exports its products. Rolcon Engineering Company Limited was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Vallabh Vidya Nagar, India.
